processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Ingot remelted 5–6 times in AM500-Edmund Buhler GmbH arc melter without breaking vacuum for better elemental intermixing.

Modified route applies high-speed HR at 10 rpm vs 1 rpm in the previous case. Original HR description (b0010/b0018) ran at 1050 °C start to 900 °C finish in nine passes; modified-route temperature is not explicitly restated.
A30 corresponds to the 30 min annealing condition in the modified route (b0032: annealing treatment similar to previous experiments for 5–30 min).

structures.overall_structure: Banded two-phase microstructure of softer γ austenite matrix (≈64%) with B2 second phase in three morphologies — refined B2 stringer bands (≈11%), intergranular GB-B2 (≈16%), and intragranular IG-B2 (≈3.7%).

phases_present.morphology: refined B2 stringer bands (≈11%) + coarse intergranular GB-B2 (≈16%) + intragranular needle IG-B2 (≈3.7%)

precipitates.distribution: refined lamellar bands along prior rolling direction; fraction ≈11% (reduced from 16%)
coarse particles at γ grain boundaries; ≈16%

defect_interactions.interaction_type: geometrically necessary dislocation (GND) localization at γ/B2 phase interfaces
defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: dislocations released from softer γ localize around GB-B2 at phase interfaces near γ grain boundaries; strain concentrates in γ, depleting GND in the 64% γ bulk

interfaces.slip_behavior: Two-stage strain hardening: low initial n (yield point elongation) followed by steady rise through combined plastic deformation of γ and B2; B2 is nonshearable and blocks dislocation mean-free paths
interfaces.phase_evolution: Modified high-speed HR + CR refines B2 stringer bands (16%→11%), allowing softer γ to dominate and absorb plastic strain preferentially; annealing produces IG-B2 and GB-B2 precipitation
interfaces.interface_notes: Intergranular cracking was elusive in the modified material despite heterogeneous strain distribution.

measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: ASTM E8, rolling direction (RD), gauge length 12.5 mm, gauge width 3 mm, thickness 2 mm

tensile_properties.stress_strain_curves: Engineering stress–strain curves of modified samples (A5, A15, A30) shown in Figure 6a; panel (a) not supplied in image description

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: 100 kN Instron 5982 with 10 mm gauge extensometer
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: room temperature; 1 mm/min crosshead velocity; ASTM E8; RD; gauge length 12.5 mm, width 3 mm, thickness 2 mm
characterization_methods.purpose: measure engineering stress–strain response, yield strength, elongation and toughness
characterization_methods.key_findings: modified A30: YS ≈1 GPa, ~30% elongation, toughness 1.72 kJ mol^-1 (238 J cm^-3); best ductility among modified annealed samples

characterization_methods.technique: Holloman's plot (ln σ vs ln ε) strain-hardening analysis
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: true stress–true strain curves; equation σ = k ε^n in logarithmic form
characterization_methods.key_findings: A30: n = 0.054 (initial stage) then n = 0.27 (second stage)

characterization_methods.technique: optical microscopy of deformed tensile gauge
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: deformed tensile gauge near specimen edge
characterization_methods.purpose: assess crack susceptibility and B2 stringer band behavior after tensile deformation
characterization_methods.key_findings: modified A30 shows B2 stringer bands and a micro-crack at specimen edge; reduced crack susceptibility

unmapped_findings: Abstract (b0003) reports the process-controlled outcome as 'nearly 1 GPa yield strength, 28% total elongation, and over 1.7 kJ mol^-1 (238.4 J cm^-3) toughness'; conclusion (b0044) reports '1 GPa with 30% elongation'. Both appear to describe modified A30 (best ductility/toughness), with a 28% vs 30% elongation discrepancy.

IG-B2 size/fraction values (needle-shaped 0.2 μm / 2.6% in URE-γ; spherical coarse 0.29 μm / 1.1% in RE-γ; total 66 MPa precipitation strengthening) are reported in b0026/b0040 in relation to Figure 3 (regular annealing route); attribution to modified A30 is ambiguous, although 2.6% + 1.1% = 3.7% matches the IG-B2 fraction stated for the modified microstructure in b0033.

Phase fractions 64% γ (b0033/b0046), 16% GB-B2 and 3.7% IG-B2 (b0033), and 11% refined B2 stringer bands (b0032) are reported at the modified-route level rather than isolated specifically to A30-modified alone.

Figure 6a (engineering stress–strain curves of modified A5/A15/A30) is not supplied in the image description; only textual values (YS ≈1 GPa, ~30% elongation, toughness 1.72 kJ/mol for A30) are extractable.

The toughness value (1.72 kJ mol^-1 / 238 J cm^-3) refers to energy absorbed before fracture calculated from the area under the stress–strain curves (inset Figure 6a), not a fracture-toughness K measurement.
